data.desc: Uranium Royalty Corp. (NASDAQ: UROY) is the largest U.S. non-precious metal royalty and streaming platform with exposure to uranium, energy and industrial supply chains. UROY provides investors with uranium commodity price exposure through strategic acquisitions in uranium interests, including royalties, streams, debt and equity in uranium companies, as well as through the trading of physical uranium. Through a transformational combination with Sweetwater Royalties in 2026, UROY substantially expanded and diversified its asset base, including interests in trona assets. UROY is also the second largest public company landowner in the U.S. and the largest landowner in Wyoming, providing significant long-term optionality across uranium, critical minerals, energy and other development opportunities.
